title: No site-level armed-presence data loaded yet
detail: The IPIS open-data geoserver is offline while IPIS migrates providers. The mining-site base layer (CSV/GeoJSON via a download form) still has to be pulled, so the map shows only hand-entered sites.

title: M23 area-of-influence polygons are not public and are not site-precise
detail: IPIS maps M23 influence to May 2026, but no shapefile is published and IPIS warns the polygons (±10 km) can't settle control of a specific mine. Polygons must be requested or digitised, and labelled as approximate.

title: Lomera has no verified coordinates
detail: Amnesty locates Lomera in Kabare territory, South Kivu, but no source we read gives coordinates, so it does not appear on the map.

title: The January 2026 Rubaya death toll is contested
detail: Counts range from 'over 200' (M23-appointed officials) to about 400 (civil society) and over 430 bodies (a rescuer). The widely quoted '227' comes from an anonymous source whose page we could not read.

title: The UAE's share of Rwandan gold is unconfirmed
detail: Rwanda says the UAE took 63.9% of its formal goods exports in 2024 and that gold is a main export there, but we have no gold-specific figure. Check UN Comtrade HS 7108.

title: Reuters reporting on Boss Mining Solution not yet read
detail: Figures reported by Reuters (Jul 2025) are known only from search snippets and are not shown.

title: No smelter → brand links yet
detail: SEC Conflict Minerals Reports and RMI status for the eight smelters still need to be pulled (Phase 3, Route 4).

title: No ownership data for unsanctioned Rwandan exporters
detail: Sayari has no Rwandan corporate registry coverage, so ownership of the Global Witness-named exporters is unknown. Their link to conflict coltan rests on Global Witness evidence, not on ownership.

title: Two of ITSCI's six suspensions are not yet identified
detail: Four suspensions are verified by name and date. A reported Rani Mining suspension (Jul 2026) and one more could not be confirmed from ITSCI's own pages.

title: Sanctions have not reached the named coltan exporters
detail: US and EU sanctions hit the gold refinery, the army, the defence ministry and a bank, plus DRC-side and Hong Kong actors. None of the Rwandan coltan exporters Global Witness names has been designated.

title: Two 2026 OFAC actions not yet added
detail: Treasury's June 2026 release refers to actions on 30 Apr 2026 (Joseph Kabila) and 2 Jun 2026 (FDLR and M23 commanders). Their primary releases have not been read yet.

title: Outcome of the EU–Rwanda minerals MoU review unknown
detail: No primary Commission document on how the review ended was found.

title: No one has measured how much of the export gap is armed-group material
detail: UN investigators and Global Witness tie the rise in Rwanda's exports to M23 areas in timing and scale, but no source splits the gap between M23, other armed groups, non-armed Congolese sources, neighbouring countries or stockpiles. Our coltan gap figure is an inferred estimate.

title: Trade records cover only part of Rwanda's exports
detail: Sayari has no Rwandan customs data; most rows are Tanzanian transit records. There are no rows for 2021–22 and almost none for Jan–Aug 2024, so the trade records can't test what happened when M23 took Rubaya. Gold leaves by air and is not covered.
